tia: FYI we're seeing bursty p95 on apac-shelf s3 starting ~02:40 UTC. pattern: short sharp spikes lasting 20-40s every ~3m.

omar: Any noisy tenants pinned to that shelf? Could be a nightly collector or a long decode job.

ops-bot: [ALERT] apac-shelf/s3: p95 inference latency > 500ms (rule: infra.latency.burst)

lucy: pulling recent placement map. shelf s3 has mixed dedicated-slice-1 + shared-burst tenants; iirc a recent deploy of tenant-dataflow increased prefetch workers.

tia: paste of small metric window:
```
2026-03-22T02:41:12Z shelf=s3 node5 gpu0 util=87 mem_bw=95GB/s nvlink=60Gb/s
2026-03-22T02:41:12Z shelf=s3 node5 gpu1 util=12 mem_bw=15GB/s nvlink=10Gb/s
2026-03-22T02:41:12Z shelf=s3 node6 gpu0 util=85 mem_bw=90GB/s nvlink=58Gb/s
```

omar: pattern looks like fabric contention again. But note node5's NIC tx spikes at same timestamps (host io). Could be S3/efs sync from dataflow.

lucy: mitigation options: 1) soft-migrate dataflow prefetch workers to ephemeral-burst pool, 2) apply bandwidth cap on tenant-dataflow egress, 3) carve out dedicated slice for latency-critical pods.

tia: quick low-risk: (1) move prefetch label off shelf s3 for 10m. can you run placement dry-run and show which pods move?

omar: running dry-run: moving 6 prefetch pods from node5/node6 -> ephemeral-burst-2 (succeeds), 1 pod respects PDB. I'll do a live reschedule with 90s grace.

ops-bot: user omar invoked placement reschedule (label=prefetch) on shelf s3

tia: p95 dropped to ~210ms after 2 pods moved. good signal. leave rule in place for 30m.

lucy: long-term: add per-tenant egress quotas for prefetch heavy workloads and surface per-node NIC + nvlink per-tenant on console. also add alert for recurring short-bursts (count>5 in 30m).

omar: agreed. i'll file an infra task for quota + dashboard (infra-issue-7123). tia: want to draft short incident note for #incidents?

tia: will post a 4-line summary and owners. closing loop once 30m stable. :white_check_mark:
